sections.title: Greetings
sections.content: Spanish picks its greeting by the time of day. 'Buenos días' runs until about midday, 'buenas tardes' through the afternoon, and 'buenas noches' after dark — the last one works both for arriving and for saying goodnight. 'Hola' fits any hour and any level of formality, so it is the safe choice when you are unsure.
'Adiós' can sound final. Between people who expect to meet again, 'hasta luego' is far more common — it is the everyday goodbye.
